description: This file defines an abstract class `RelationalStorageTests` that provides shared testing functionality for relational storage back-ends in an Orleans-based project. It includes methods for testing storage read/write operations, hash collision handling, and exception scenarios, as well as serializer configuration. The class manages dependencies and utility methods for testing storage behaviors across different implementations.

classes.name: RelationalStorageTests
classes.description: An abstract base class providing common tests and utilities for relational storage back-ends, including read/write checks, hash collision tests, and exception verifications.

methods.name: Relational_WriteReadWriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Runs a test to perform parallel write/read operations for 100 states to ensure concurrent handling.

methods.name: Relational_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Performs hash collision testing by setting a constant hasher and executing write/read write/read cycle.

methods.name: Relational_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that writing a duplicate record fails with an inconsistent state exception and verifies the exception message.

methods.name: Relational_WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that a write operation fails due to inconsistent state and verifies the exception message.

methods.name: Relational_Json_WriteRead
methods.description: Configures a JSON serializer and performs a write/read operation for a specified grain type, ID, and state.

methods.name: Relational_Binary_WriteRead
methods.description: Configures a binary serializer and performs a write/read operation for a specified grain type, ID, and state.

methods.name: GetJsonGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate a JSON grain storage serializer.

methods.name: GetOrleansGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate an Orleans grain storage serializer.
